# Your personas

You are not one reader. Each persona has its own picks, its own graph and its own list of articles kept in it or put out of it, and grows from what you read while it is the active one. Start from one of five personas made from what this site publishes, or from nothing, and give it a name.

Personas need JavaScript: they live in your browser.

Kept in this browser with your balance and history, and exported and restored with them from [your account](index.md#restore). Anyone who uses this browser can see them; "Start again" on the account page clears them.
